Name: Ore spawn rate rebalance for Geology by IgneousInsanity
Author: S13NDR
Description:
*** ONLY USE THIS FILE TO REDUCE CUSTOM ORE NODES SPAWN RATES ***

A replacement  custom_ore_nodes JSON configuration file for The Geology Mod by IgneousInsanity that reduces the spawn rate for most minerals by half and reduces the spawn rate of prismatic rocks to 0.01 at mine levels above 120

The original mod is still required to use this file, this is simply a JSON that you can past into the mod folder labeled [CON]

Cheers

Downloads.Description:
JSON replacer.

Past the file into the [CON] folder and allow replacement of the original JSON to use. Perhaps wise to retain a copy of the original elsewhere if you would like to be able to revert changes.
